title: Again!!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kin'ichiro Imamura, mistaken for a delinquent because of his looks, reaches graduation with no friends and no club. A fall on the last day sends him, and popular classmate Akira Fujieda, back to their first day of high school, and he joins the struggling oendan (cheering squad) to keep it from being disbanded.
life_message: A good life is one lived with others: throw yourself into cheering for people and a shared cause instead of standing apart with regrets.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Pride in the oendan's name and anthem matters, but disputes are settled through club rules and effort.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Club discipline and the captain's extreme work ethic frame achievement.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty is to the school community and club, not family.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Senior captain leads; club traditions and ranks are respected.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Saving the old-fashioned oendan against the cheer squad's modern view is the core goal.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Focus is personal fulfillment and youthful experience, not material security.

folkways.japan: The oendan is a real Japanese school tradition of male cheering squads with strict senpai-kohai discipline and anthem singing.

delivery.evidence: Summaries show the theme through Imamura's choices and club revival; no reviewer comment on preachiness found (to verify).

personified.ideology: Total devotion to an old school tradition

delivery.note: The tradition-versus-modern dispute between the oendan and cheer squad is carried by rival club leaders.

winners_losers: Imamura and the oendan members who commit to the club gain sympathy; isolation and the cheer squad's dismissal of tradition are what the story pushes against.
